THIRD-PARTY NOTICES: Falcon PL
==============================

Falcon PL is Copyright (c) 2026 BEARTEC LTD. All rights reserved. See LICENSE.

The Falcon PL binaries (falcon-pl-node, falcon-pl-ctl, fpl-gateway, fpl-operator)
are built from BEARTEC LTD code and the open-source components listed below.
Each component is used under the licence shown and keeps its own copyright
notice. Where a crate offers a choice of licences (for example "MIT OR
Apache-2.0"), the licence shown is the one under which BEARTEC LTD uses it.

This file is generated from the Cargo.lock files by
falcon-pl-rs/scripts/generate-third-party-notices.sh (cargo-about). It must be
included with every future Falcon PL release and operator kit. Releases that
were already published have not been changed.

Acknowledgements
----------------
BEARTEC LTD acknowledges OpenZeppelin (https://github.com/OpenZeppelin),
rukafe0x and ZKNox. Their work was used only in a separate, unrelated
Starknet/Falcon Challenge experiment; it is not included in Falcon PL
production builds.

Not covered by the generated list below:
  * BitVM (https://github.com/BitVM/BitVM, MIT) is fetched at build time by
    scripts/fetch-bitvm.sh and is not committed; tools/bitvm-c1b-export depends
    on it. Its licence is kept at falcon-pl-rs/tools/fpl-bridge/patches/BitVM-LICENSE-MIT.
  * pqcrypto-falcon bundles the PQClean Falcon reference implementation (MIT).
  * The falcon-dag-rs git submodule is covered separately.
